Own vTaskDelay resets only maximum-work burst count and never renews idle epoch grace
Age >=4 ticks immediately yields even for first unit in a newly observed idle epoch
Maximum 32-unit bound remains; one vTaskDelay(1) maximum per checkpoint; real idle fields are unchanged
No capture cap, raw-data transformation, watchdog feed, hardware lock or transport deadline changed
Shared fields stay aligned internal DRAM; additional epoch count remains private to its worker
SCHED extrema 484 B fit 512 B per author/root executed real formatter test
results: Six independent production-component scenarios PASS; 13 budget + 15 drain + 5 BLE production-body scenarios PASS. Seven continually ready worker models passed 100/500/1000 us unit costs at 0/9500 us phases with observed maximum idle gaps of 2/3 ticks.
